# Posting schedule

**Cadence, posting windows, CSV calendars and an approval-batched schedule()/tick() pipeline that respects caps and time zones.**

Builds and runs a posting schedule for an AI influencer or agent across X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Threads, Telegram and Discord — picking cadence per platform, posting windows from 2026 research and then from the account's own analytics, a CSV content calendar, timezone and daylight-saving handling, and an approval-batched pipeline with @useclaudia/social `schedule()` and `tick()` that stays inside daily caps, link limits and X pay-per-use costs. Use when someone asks how often or when to post, wants a weekly or launch calendar, needs to turn a calendar into scheduled posts, has posts arriving late or missing ("Posting late?"), or wants an autonomous agent to pace itself without spamming.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 45 min to set up, 20 min a week to run | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Set the cadence
2. Pick posting windows
3. Fill the calendar
4. Check the plan before drafting anything
5. Draft the week with scheduleAt, submit for approval
6. Approve the week in one batch
7. Run the clock
8. Pace an autonomous agent
9. Review weekly

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/posting-schedule.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/posting-schedule.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/posting-schedule.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/posting-schedule.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill posting-schedule`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `posting-schedule.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/posting-schedule`.
